_meta.note: Captured off the wire: `opencode acp` driven over stdio, agent-to-client lines verbatim and in order. The slice this file exists for is the MANUAL /compact turn, which is the evidence ACP_BACKENDS_COMPACT and ACP_BACKENDS_INLINE_COMPACTION hold their members to. Read in order: a usage_update from an ordinary turn, that turn's stopReason, then the /compact turn -- whose agent_message_chunk carries a structured summary, whose usage_update reports a far smaller `used`, and whose result is stopReason end_turn with NO compaction status frame of any kind. That absence is the point: the turn's own terminal frame is the only done signal this harness gives, which is why wait_for_compaction answers from the capability rather than from the queue. The thought-chunk stream of the summariser is dropped -- it is model prose, it carries no required class, and it is the bulk of the capture. The growth series proving the meter falls across turns (used 14863 -> 15727 -> 16614 -> 17478, then 14577 on the next ordinary turn after /compact) is a separate longer drive recorded in the PR that added this file; the single-turn drop below is what one session shows. The available_commands_update frames are dropped, as in every sibling fixture here: the command inventory is the recording host's own, which check_acp_frame_host_data refuses. What that frame showed -- opencode advertising no compaction command at all -- is recorded on ACP_BACKENDS_COMPACT instead. Working directory was a scratch project.
